DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この展示会場では、どのエリアをご覧になる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which areas do you plan to visit at this exhibition venue?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 船の模型だけ見たいです。三十分後に迎えが来るので、遠くの建物までは行けません。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三十分の時間制限と模型見学を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: I only want to see the model ships. My ride is coming in thirty minutes, so I can't go as far as the distant building.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Mention your thirty-minute time limit and your wish to see the models. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 模型展示はこの仮設会場の中央です。出口が二つあるので、迎えの場所も決めておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: The model exhibition is in the center of this temporary venue. There are two exits, so let's also decide where you'll be picked up.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 迎えは東側の出口に頼んでいます。模型を見たあと、同じ出口に戻れる道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 迎えの東出口へ戻る経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've arranged to be picked up at the east exit. Is there a route back to that same exit after seeing the models?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for a route back to the east exit where you will be picked up. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中央の展示を回って東側へ戻れます。ただ、今日はこちらの通路を展示準備のため閉じています。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can go around the central exhibition and return to the east side. However, this passage is closed today for exhibition preparations.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 閉じた通路を通らず、広い通路で戻ります。準備中の区画には近づかないほうがいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 閉鎖通路を避ける方針を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll avoid the closed passage and return along the wide one. I should stay away from the area being prepared, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will avoid the closed passage. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。見学者用の矢印に沿って進んでください。模型の説明を読む時間も含めて余裕を見てくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please follow the visitor arrows. Allow enough time to read the model descriptions too.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 説明を全部読むより、二つの模型に絞ります。出口付近で待てる所も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見る模型を絞り待機場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: Rather than read all the descriptions, I'll focus on two models. Please also tell me where I can wait near the exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Limit the models you will see and ask for a waiting area. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出口の内側に待機用の椅子があります。車道には出ず、迎えが着いたら連絡を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: There are waiting chairs inside the exit. Don't go out onto the roadway; wait to be contacted when your ride arrives.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つ見たら椅子に戻り、車が来たと連絡があるまで中で待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 車道に出ず連絡を待つと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: After seeing the two models, I'll return to the chairs and wait inside until I'm told the car has arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to wait for contact without going onto the roadway. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ時間に余裕をもって。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please leave yourself plenty of time. Enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 入浴の準備でお困りのことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you need help with while getting ready to bathe?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: タオルを忘れました。こちらの架空の宿では、借りられるものと買うものが分かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 忘れたタオルの貸出と購入を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: I forgot my towel. At this fictional inn, are the towels you can borrow different from the ones you buy?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about borrowing or buying a towel because you forgot yours. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 貸し出し用のバスタオルと、購入用の小さなタオルをご用意しています。料金はこの表示でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have bath towels to borrow and small towels to buy. Please check this notice for the prices.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: バスタオルだけ借ります。入浴するとき、湯船のふちに置いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: バスタオルを選び置き場所を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll borrow just a bath towel. When bathing, may I leave it on the edge of the bath?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose a bath towel and check where to put it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 湯船に落ちないよう、脱衣所か指定の棚に置いてください。小さいタオルも湯の中には入れないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please leave it in the changing room or on the designated shelf so it doesn't fall into the bath. Please don't put small towels in the bathwater either.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 棚に置きます。体を洗ってから湯船に入り、出るときにも床をぬらしすぎないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 指定棚と洗身の行動を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll put it on the shelf. I'll wash my body before entering the bath, and I'd also like to avoid getting the floor too wet when I come out.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will use the designated shelf and wash your body. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 脱衣所へ戻る前に、水気を拭いてください。気分が悪くなった場合は無理に入浴を続けないでくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please dry off before returning to the changing room. If you feel unwell, don't force yourself to keep bathing.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は疲れているので、短めに入ります。借りたタオルは部屋へ持ち帰らずに返すのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 短時間入浴と返却方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm tired today, so I'll keep my bath short. Should I return the borrowed towel without taking it back to my room?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Discuss a short bath and how to return the towel. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この貸し出し分は、入浴後に入口の回収かごへお願いします。貴重品はご自身で管理してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: For these borrowed towels, please use the collection basket at the entrance after bathing. You are responsible for your own valuables.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、荷物をしまい、短時間だけ入って、タオルを回収かごに返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物管理とタオル返却を確約する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll put away my belongings, bathe only briefly, and return the towel to the collection basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Commit to managing your belongings and returning the towel. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ごゆっくり、無理のないようお過ごしください。では、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please relax and don't overdo it. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日のご宿泊ですね。予約を照合しますので、お名前を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're staying with us tonight. May I have your name so I can check your reservation?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: グエン・アンです。ただ、予約メールの名前が一文字違います。予約番号で確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 綴り違いと予約番号照合を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: Nguyen An. However, one letter in the name on the booking email is wrong. Could you check using the reservation number?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Mention the spelling error and ask for a check using the reservation number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約番号とメールをご提示ください。人数と泊数も照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the reservation number and email. I'll also check the number of guests and nights.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。一名で二泊、禁煙の部屋を予約しました。名前以外は合っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 人数泊数と禁煙希望を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here they are. I booked a nonsmoking room for one person for two nights. Everything except the name is correct.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the number of guests and nights and the nonsmoking preference. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予約は見つかりました。氏名の訂正は本人確認後に行います。身分証をお見せいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've found the reservation. We'll correct the name after verifying your identity. May I see your identification?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、こちらです。まだ部屋に入れないなら、荷物だけ預けて外出したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人確認と入室前の荷物預かりを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, here it is. If I can't enter the room yet, I'd like to leave just my luggage and go out.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Verify your identity and ask to leave your luggage before gaining access to the room. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 部屋の準備状況を確認します。荷物預かりについても、点数と内容を先に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check whether the room is ready. For luggage storage, I'll first ask how many pieces you have and what's in them.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: スーツケース一つです。財布とパソコンは自分で持ちます。戻ったときは何を見せればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 預ける荷物と貴重品と受取方法を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: One suitcase. I'll keep my wallet and computer with me. What should I show when I return?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the luggage to store, your valuables, and how you will collect it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この架空の受付では預かり票をお渡しします。荷物の受け取り時にご提示ください。部屋の準備完了は戻られた時に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: At this fictional reception desk, we give you a luggage claim ticket. Please show it when collecting your luggage. We'll check whether the room is ready when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 預かり票を失くさないようにします。予約名の訂正も済んだことをメールか画面で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 預かり票保管と氏名訂正確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll make sure not to lose the claim ticket. I'd also like to confirm by email or on a screen that the booking name has been corrected.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the claim ticket safe and ask to confirm the name correction. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 訂正内容をこちらでご確認ください。荷物をお預かりしますので、どうぞお気をつけて。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the correction here. We'll keep your luggage for you. Take care while you're out.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ち帰りのご注文ですね。温かいものと冷たいもの、どちらになさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're ordering to take away. Would you like something hot or cold?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 温かいコーヒーを一つください。歩いて持ち帰るので、こぼれにくいふたにできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 温かいコーヒーと漏れにくいふたを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: One hot coffee, please. I'll walk home with it, so could you use a lid that won't spill easily?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Order hot coffee and request a lid that is less likely to leak. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 持ち帰り用のふたを付けます。ただ、横にすると漏れることがあります。袋もお付けしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll put on a takeaway lid. However, it may leak if turned sideways. Would you like a bag too?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 袋をお願いします。砂糖は別にして、ミルクは入れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋と砂糖別添えとミルクなしを指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: A bag, please. Put the sugar on the side, and don't add milk.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify a bag, sugar separately, and no milk. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: コーヒー一つ、ミルクなし、砂糖は別ですね。受け取りまで、こちらでお待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: One coffee, no milk, sugar on the side. Could you wait here until it's ready?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。名前を呼ばれるのか、番号で受け取るのか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受取時の呼び出し方式を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Please tell me whether you'll call my name or I'll collect it by number.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how you will be called to collect your order. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この注文では番号札をお渡しします。できあがったら番号を呼びますので、カウンターへお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: For this order, we'll give you a number ticket. We'll call the number when it's ready, so please come to the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三番ですね。受け取ったとき、ふたがきちんとはまっているか一緒に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号とふたの確認希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: Number three, then. When I collect it, I'd like us to check together that the lid is properly fitted.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the number and say that you want to check the lid. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。できあがりましたので、こちらへどうぞ。ふたの縁が一周はまっているのをご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. It's ready now; please come over. Check that the lid's edge is fitted all the way around.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認できました。熱いので袋をまっすぐ持って帰ります。砂糖も入っていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ふたと砂糖を確認し持ち方を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked it. It's hot, so I'll keep the bag upright on my way home. The sugar is in there too, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the lid and sugar and say how you will carry it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、別添えの砂糖も入っています。ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, the separate sugar is in there too. Thank you. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は歩行者通路側の片付けをお願いします。作業前に、搬入口の位置を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please clean up along the pedestrian passage today. Before starting, let's check the delivery entrance's location.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この線の内側ですね。資材を倉庫へ戻すには搬入口を横切りそうですが、今通ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 搬入口を横切る可否を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: Inside this line, right? Taking the materials back to the warehouse would mean crossing the delivery entrance. May I cross now?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether you may cross the delivery entrance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今は車両の搬入中なので、横切らないでください。誘導員の管理する区域です。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: Vehicles are making deliveries now, so don't cross. That area is controlled by the traffic guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、倉庫へ運ぶ作業はいったん止めます。通路側のごみだけ先に集めてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 倉庫運搬を止め別作業を提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I'll stop moving things to the warehouse for now. May I collect just the rubbish along the passage first?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Stop transporting to the warehouse and suggest another task. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。ただし、歩行者の幅を狭めない場所に置いてください。置き場所はこの囲いの中です。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, but put it somewhere that doesn't narrow the space for pedestrians. The designated place is inside this enclosure.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 囲いまで運びます。途中で割れた板を見つけたら、手で拾わず報告するのでいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 割れた板の報告と回収方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll carry it to the enclosure. If I find a broken board along the way, should I report it instead of picking it up by hand?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about reporting a broken board and how it should be collected. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その通りです。釘が出ている可能性があります。位置を伝えて、回収方法の指示を待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's right. There may be protruding nails. Tell us its location and wait for instructions on how to collect it.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 承知しました。釘のある板には触らず、その位置をお伝えします。搬入が終わったかも、自分で判断しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 釘付き板を触らず再開を自己判断しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I won't touch a board with nails; I'll report its location. I also won't decide for myself whether the deliveries have finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you won't touch a board with nails or decide on your own when to resume. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 倉庫へ運ぶ再開の合図は私から出します。誘導員の合図は車両用の場合があるので、取り違えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll give the signal to resume moving things to the warehouse. The traffic guide's signals may be for vehicles, so don't confuse them.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 再開は監督からの指示を待ちます。それまでは通路側の片付けだけにして、囲いにごみを置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 監督指示を待ち限定作業を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait for the supervisor's instruction to resume. Until then, I'll only clean up along the passage and put the rubbish in the enclosure.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will wait for the supervisor's instruction and limit yourself to the specified task. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、安全を確かめて取りかかってください。こちらは離れますが、不明な点は無線で呼んでください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then check it's safe and get started. I'll be away, but call me on the radio if anything is unclear. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 給与の受け取りに使う口座をご希望ですね。勤務先から指定された条件はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want an account to receive your salary. Has your employer specified any requirements?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社は口座名義を在留カードと同じにしてほしいと言っています。まだ口座はなく、来月から給与が出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与開始と名義条件を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: The company wants the account-holder name to match my residence card. I don't have an account yet, and my salary starts next month.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State when your salary starts and the requirement for the account-holder name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本人確認と申込み条件を確認する必要があります。お持ちの資料を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check your identity and the application requirements. What documents have you brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 在留カードと勤務先の通知があります。住所を変えたばかりなので、カードの住所も確認していただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持参資料と住所変更を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: My residence card and a notice from my employer. I've just changed my address, so I'd also like you to check the address on the card.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the documents you brought and your change of address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の住所の記載を確認します。資料によっては追加の確認が必要ですので、今日開設が終わるとはお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the current address listed. Depending on the documents, further checks may be needed, so we can't promise the account will be opened today.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社へ、今日申請したことと開設がまだ確定していないことを分けて伝えたいです。受付後に進み具合を確かめる方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 申請と開設を区別し進捗確認を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to tell my company separately that I applied today and that the account opening isn't confirmed yet. Is there a way to check progress after the application is accepted?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish applying from opening the account and ask how to check progress. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まず申込みが受け付けられるか確認し、受付後の連絡方法はその時にご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: First, we'll check whether we can accept your application. We'll explain how to contact us afterward when it's accepted.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ受付できるかも未確認なんですね。足りないものがあれば、名前をメモしたいので一つずつ教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未受付の状態を理解し不足資料の名称を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: So whether you can accept it hasn't been checked yet either. If anything is missing, please tell me each item's name one at a time so I can write it down.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show that you understand the application hasn't been accepted yet and ask for the names of missing documents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認した不足資料は書面でお渡しします。会社へ提出する口座情報も、開設後に内容を確認してからお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll give you a written list of any missing documents we identify. Please also check the account information after the account is opened before giving it to your company.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、書類を見ていただきます。会社には今の段階を正確に伝え、口座番号ができたとは言わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料確認と会社への正確な報告を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll have you check my documents. I'll accurately tell my company the current stage and won't say an account number has been created.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to have the documents checked and report accurately to your company. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず資料確認の担当へご案内します。お気をつけて、いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. First, I'll direct you to the staff who check documents. Take care on your way.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 列車が遅れており、次の案内を待っています。乗り継ぎのご予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: The train is delayed, and we're waiting for further information. Do you have a connection planned?

DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 病院で十時半の予約があります。あと二十分で着く予定でしたが、いま動いていないのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 病院予約時刻と列車の運転状況を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a hospital appointment at 10:30. I was due to arrive in twenty minutes, but is the train not running now?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give your hospital appointment time and ask about train operations. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、発車を見合わせています。再開の情報はまだありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: That's right, departures are suspended. We don't have information about resumption yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 病院には到着が遅れる可能性を伝えます。遅れた理由を説明する資料は、こちらで確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 病院への遅延連絡と説明資料の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll tell the hospital I may arrive late. Can I check here about documentation explaining the reason for the delay?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will notify the hospital about the delay and ask about explanatory documentation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 証明の扱いは改札でご確認ください。現在わかる情報と、まだ決まっていない時刻を分けてお伝えするとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please ask at the ticket gates about delay certificates. It would be good to distinguish what is currently known from times that haven't been decided yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: わかりました。病院へ電話したら、診察の順番を確認するので到着見込みがわかったら再度連絡してほしいと言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 病院から到着見込みの再連絡を求められたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I called the hospital, and they said they'd check the consultation order and wanted me to contact them again once I know my expected arrival time.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the hospital asked you to call again with your expected arrival time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、新しい運行情報が出たときにご確認ください。今の段階で何分後に着くとは申し上げられません。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then please check when new service information is released. At this point, I can't tell you how many minutes it will take to arrive.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 待っている間に座りたいです。放送が聞こえる待合室へ移ってもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 放送が聞こえる待合室への移動を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to sit while waiting. May I move to a waiting room where I can hear the announcements?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about moving to a waiting room where announcements can be heard. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの待合室では放送が流れます。案内板もありますので、時刻だけでなくお知らせ欄もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Announcements are played in this waiting room. There's also an information board, so please check the notices as well as the times.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 待合室で情報を確かめ、見込みが出てから病院へもう一度電話します。予約を取り直せたとはまだ考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 運行見込み判明後の再連絡と予約未変更を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the information in the waiting room and call the hospital again once an estimate is available. I won't assume my appointment has already been rescheduled.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will call again once the service outlook is known and that the appointment hasn't been changed yet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのようにご確認ください。待合室へどうぞ。いったん失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check that way. Go ahead to the waiting room. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の痛みの欄で、わからない言葉がありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Was there a word you didn't understand in the pain section of the medical questionnaire?

DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: しびれという言葉がよくわかりません。指先がピリピリして、冷たい物を持つと感じ方が変わるのですが、これもそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: しびれの意味と指先の感覚を聞き返す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I don't really understand the word “numbness.” My fingertips tingle, and the sensation changes when I hold something cold. Does that count too?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the meaning of numbness and describe the feeling in your fingertips. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: しびれにはピリピリする感じや感覚の鈍さなどがあります。ただ、言葉を選ぶだけで判断せず、ご自身の感じ方をそのまま教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Numbness includes feelings like tingling and reduced sensation. However, rather than judging just by choosing a word, please tell us exactly how it feels to you.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 右手の小指だけがピリピリします。昨日の夜からで、痛いというより触った感じが薄いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 部位と気づいた時期と感覚低下を具体化する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only the little finger on my right hand tingles. It's been that way since last night; rather than pain, it's more that touch feels less distinct.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify the location, when you noticed it, and the reduced sensation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その表現で記録します。力の入りにくさや、ほかの場所の症状にも気づいていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll record it that way. Have you also noticed difficulty applying force or symptoms elsewhere?

DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 左手は普通です。右手でふたを開けるときに力が入りにくい気がしますが、どの程度かは説明しづらいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 左右差と力の入りにくさの不確実性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: My left hand is normal. I feel I have trouble applying force when opening a lid with my right hand, but it's hard to explain to what extent.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the difference between sides and your uncertainty about the difficulty applying force. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 説明しづらい部分も医師へ伝えます。急に始まったのか、少しずつ気づいたのかは覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll tell the doctor about the parts that are hard to explain too. Do you remember whether it began suddenly or you noticed it gradually?

DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 作業を終えた後に気づきました。始まった瞬間はわかりません。いつもより長く工具を握っていたことも伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 開始時刻不明と工具使用の経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I noticed it after finishing work. I don't know the moment it started. I'd also like to mention that I was gripping tools longer than usual.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that the onset time is unknown and describe your tool use. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 開始時刻が不明なことと、工具を使った状況を分けて記録します。原因が工具だと決まったわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll separately record the unknown onset time and the circumstances of your tool use. It hasn't been established that the tools caused it.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 工具のせいと断定せず、感じ方と作業の経緯を説明します。問診票には無理に一語で書かなくていいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原因を断定せず具体的な感覚を書くと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't assume the tools caused it; I'll explain the sensation and what happened during work. I don't need to force it into one word on the questionnaire, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will write the specific sensations without assuming a cause. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。記録した内容を医師へ引き継ぎます。変化があればお知らせください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: That's right. I'll pass the recorded details to the doctor. Please tell us if anything changes. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの冷凍食品について、どのような状態でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: What is the condition of the frozen food you've brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帰宅して冷凍庫に入れようとしたら、袋の横に穴がありました。中身は出していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷凍食品の穴と未開封を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I got home and went to put it in the freezer, I found a hole in the side of the bag. I haven't taken the contents out.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the hole in the frozen-food packaging and that you haven't opened it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 購入した時刻と、持ち帰った間の保管状況を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I ask when you bought it and how it was stored on the way home?

DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三十分前に買い、保冷バッグで持ち帰りました。穴が最初からあったかはわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 購入時刻と保冷運搬と原因不明を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I bought it thirty minutes ago and brought it home in an insulated cooler bag. I don't know whether the hole was there from the start.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the purchase time, transport in a cooler bag, and the unknown cause. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: レシートと袋を確認します。商品をお預かりして、交換などの対応を担当に確認してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the receipt and bag. May we hold the product while we ask the person in charge about an exchange or other options?

DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。穴をテープでふさいで食べればよいか迷いましたが、衛生面が心配でそのまま持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 商品を預け衛生面の心配を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I wondered whether I could tape over the hole and eat it, but I was worried about hygiene, so I brought it as it was.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Leave the product with the staff and explain your hygiene concerns. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらで食べても問題ないとは保証できません。状態と経緯を担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can't guarantee here that it's safe to eat. I'll tell the person in charge about its condition and what happened.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 食べずに相談してよかったです。同じ商品へ替えられる場合でも、新しい袋に破れがないか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 交換品も包装を確認したいと求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm glad I asked without eating it. Even if you can exchange it for the same product, I'd like to check the new bag for tears too.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to check the packaging of any replacement too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 交換になるかは確認後にご説明します。新しい商品をご用意する際には、包装の状態も一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll explain whether it will be exchanged after checking. If we prepare a new product, let's inspect its packaging together too.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。返金か交換かが決まるまで待ちます。原因が不明なこともそのまま伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対応確定を待ち原因不明の申告を保つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll wait until it's decided whether it will be a refund or exchange. Please also report as it is that the cause is unknown.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait for the response to be decided and maintain that the cause is unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認してご説明します。お持ちいただきありがとうございました。少しの間、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll check and explain. Thank you for bringing it. Please excuse me for a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお惣菜の表示をお調べですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you checking the label on this prepared food?

DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。昼に買って夕方に食べたいのですが、冷蔵庫がありません。保存方法を一緒に確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夕方まで冷蔵不可の状況と保存方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to buy it at lunchtime and eat it in the evening, but I don't have a refrigerator. Could you check the storage instructions with me?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you can't refrigerate it until evening and ask about storage. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この商品には要冷蔵と書かれています。夕方まで常温で持ち歩いてよい商品とはご案内できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: This product says “Keep refrigerated.” We can't advise you that it's suitable to carry around at room temperature until evening.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、その惣菜はやめます。常温保存と書かれた商品なら、そのまま選べばいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 要冷蔵品を除き常温表示の判断を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I won't take that prepared food. If a product says it can be stored at room temperature, can I simply choose it?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Rule out the refrigerated item and check how to judge room-temperature labeling. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 直射日光や高温を避けるなどの注意もあります。保存方法の欄を最後まで確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: There are also precautions such as avoiding direct sunlight and high temperatures. Please read the storage instructions all the way through.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 屋外で長く持つので、日が当たる場所に置くのも避けます。このパンの原材料に乳は入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 屋外保管への配慮と乳の原材料を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll be carrying it outdoors for a long time, so I'll also avoid leaving it in the sun. Does this bread contain milk as an ingredient?
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Mention precautions for outdoor storage and ask about milk in the ingredients. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらには乳成分と表示されています。避けたい原材料がある場合は、注意書きも含めてご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: This one lists milk components. If there are ingredients you want to avoid, please read the warnings too.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 乳を避けたい家族に渡すので、このパンも選びません。別の商品の表示を自分で比べてから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族の乳回避条件と別商品の比較を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's for a family member who wants to avoid milk, so I won't choose this bread either. I'll compare other products' labels myself before deciding.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain your family's milk-avoidance requirement and your plan to compare other products. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: わからない表示があればお声がけください。表示を見ただけで、すべての方に安全と保証することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask if there's labeling you don't understand. Looking at a label alone doesn't let us guarantee it's safe for everyone.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族にも条件を確認してから買います。今日は飲み物だけにして、冷蔵の物は家へ直接帰るときに買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族確認前の購入を保留し飲料だけを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the requirements with my family before buying too. Today I'll only buy drinks and get refrigerated items when I'm going straight home.
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Put off buying until checking with your family and choose only drinks. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。保存場所にもお気をつけて。ありがとうございました。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-035-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please also be careful where you store them. Thank you, and have a good day.
